# A European brain for a sovereign website: what changed in v1.2.0

From v1.1.0 (2026-11-20, `9a1edb2e0`) to v1.2.0 (2026-11-21, this release), paragraph by paragraph.

[← v1.1.0](v1.1.0.md) · [all versions](../a-european-brain.md)

1 unchanged paragraph

Summary: When I shared the Sovereign Agentic Website idea, someone I sent it to came back with the right challenge: if we really want to claim the word sovereign, abstract the AI provider, and let people use other models, including European ones such as Mistral. I agree completely. A site whose files are yours but whose brain can only be one American provider has a part in the middle that you do not control. So the model becomes a choice the owner makes, like the host: one standard interface, the OpenAI-style API that Mistral, OpenRouter and local servers all speak, and a European option at every level. On the Pro appliances, Ministral 3, an Apache 2.0 model built for the edge, running on the device. For the team inside the site, Mistral's API on its EU endpoint, where data is hosted in the EEA by default and processing stays in the EU, on its EU endpoint, at a small premium, and the owner can opt out of API data is notbeing used for training. For everything else, the owner's own key. We have already run Mistral in production without saying so: it was one of four open-weight models in the Swarm's 216 calls, and its free mode passed our browser test in October. The one thing to watch is licences: the Apache 2.0 models are clean, while Mistral Large 4 needs a commercial licence to be served as a service. And there is a partnership to propose.

19 unchanged paragraphs, under In short {#in-short}, The challenge {#challenge}, The model is a choice {#choice}…

• **In Europe: Mistral's API.** Data is hosted in the EEA by default ([where data is stored](https://help.mistral.ai/en/articles/347629-where-do-you-store-my-data-or-my-organization-s-data)), with an EU endpoint generally available since August 2026 ([regional endpoints](https://mistral.ai/news/regional-inference-open-models-new-compute/)),endpoints](https://mistral.ai/news/regional-inference-open-models-new-compute/)).andHosting is not processing: inference stays in the EU only on the EU endpoint, api.eu.mistral.ai, billed at 1.1 times list price ([regional inference](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/regional-inference)). Its inference page says "data sent through our API isn't used for model training" ([inference](https://mistral.ai/cloud/inference/)).([inference](https://mistral.ai/cloud/inference/)), but in Free mode Mistral may use inputs and outputs for training unless you opt out ([its help centre](https://help.mistral.ai/en/articles/347617-do-you-use-my-user-data-to-train-your-artificial-intelligence-models)). Ministral 3 8B is listed at 0.15 dollars per million tokens ([its page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/ministral-3-8b-25-12)); Mistral Small 4, an Apache 2.0 model with 119 billion parameters, 6.5 billion active, at 0.15 and 0.60 ([its page](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-small-4-0-26-03)).
